newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian late rubber stable in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian late rubber stable in slow trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were generally stable in late trading on Friday, but market sentiment remained poor on the back of low consumer demand, dealers said.
Dealers said March SIR20 was done at 53.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Padang, up by 0.50 cents/lb from morning levels. Offer prices were unchanged in Medan and Surabaya at 53.00 U.S. cents/lb.

"What I can say is that dealers expect the price to improve a bit next week. But we know that demand is still very, very low," said one dealer. Dealers said poor consumer demand from the United States, China and Europe had dampened market sentiment.
"Prices usually become firmer because of Chinese demand, but now only the markets in Europe, South Korea and Latin America are still active," said one dealer.
Dealers said they expected prices to improve in the coming weeks, but added that offshore customers were still reducing stocks.
"We also believe that buyers are still waiting for the Indonesian prices to decline further before they take any positions," another dealer said.
